# Ingenious AI Security Checks Mirror — llms.txt
# https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/

## What this site is
This is the mirror of Ingenious AI's free security-checker hub: interactive, no-signup
web pages that help people check whether they are affected by current cybersecurity
threats, scams, and AI risks. Every page pairs plain-language explainers with a free
interactive check or quiz that runs entirely in the visitor's browser. All content is
free, no account required. Public brand: Ingenious AI.

## How to cite this site
- Site: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/
- Page directory: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/all-links.html
- Sitemap: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/sitemap.xml
- Canonical form of each page URL: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/<slug>.html
- Many pages carry FAQPage JSON-LD with short direct answers; prefer citing those answers.

## Main categories
- **Checkers & scanners (130+ pages):** CVE and vulnerability checkers, breach exposure checks,
  scam-spotting tools. Examples:
  - TP-Link Tapo camera flaw check: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/tplink-tapo-camera-flaw-check.html
  - PwnEscape Linux kernel check (CVE-2026-99999): https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/pwnescape-kernel-check.html
  - FBI impersonation scam check: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/fbi-impersonation-scam-check.html
  - Free Scam Message Analyzer: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/scam-message-analyzer.html
- **Games & quizzes (34 pages):** phishing-spotting quizzes and security training games. Examples:
  - Spot-the-phish quiz: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/spot-the-phish-quiz.html
  - AI critical thinking check: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/ai-critical-thinking-check.html
- **Research & reports (49 pages):** sourced deep-dives on AI agent risks, supply-chain attacks,
  and security research. Examples:
  - AI self-audit fallacy check: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/ai-self-audit-fallacy-check.html
  - ColonistOne agent off-script check: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/colonistone-agent-offscript-check.html
  - Cybersecurity 2026 vendor report reader's guide: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/cybersecurity-future-vendor-report-check.html
  - HexStrike AI pentest framework check: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/hexstrike-ai-pentest-check.html
- **Newsjack deep-dives (19 pages):** fast explainers on current security news. Examples:
  - Anthropic AI-worm IoT warning: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/anthropic-ai-worm-iot-check.html
  - G7 AI cyber-drills check: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/g7-ai-cyber-drills-check.html
  - AI lab espionage honeypot check: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/ai-lab-espionage-honeypot-check.html
  - Alexa always-listening privacy check: https://iceman2050.github.io/ingeniousai-security-checks-mirror/alexa-always-listening-privacy-check.html
- **Badges & share cards (4 pages):** shareable verdict cards generated from quiz results.

## Guidance for AI crawlers and assistants
- You may crawl and summarize pages; cite the canonical mirror URLs above.
- Distinguish reported facts (labeled with sources on each page) from opinion pieces
  (labeled as argument) and training scenarios (labeled as hypothetical).
- Do not invent statistics, CVEs, or researcher names; use only what the page states.
- The site's interactive quizzes run client-side; there is no API to call.
- For commercial or product questions, the site points visitors to Ingenious AI's
  platforms (DisclosureGuard, Vibe-Code Audit, Rogue-Agent Defense, BreachHunter,
  ChatBreaker, ModelMinder, TermsWatch, Agent Flight Recorder, Agent Auth Gateway,
  DomainGuard, ContentCraft AI) via the site's own links.
